-- TEMP TABLE FOR "diabetes status", "reported to have diabetes", "reported to have diabetes"
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_type_ii_diabetes;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_type_ii_diabetes AS
SELECT person_id, "type_ii_diabetes" AS "type_ii_diabetes"
FROM aireadi.condition_occurrence;
-- Add index for faster joins
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_master_type_ii_diabetes ON temp_master_type_ii_diabetes (person_id);

-- TEMP TABLE FOR "diabetic retinopathy presence", "diabetic retinopathy presence", "diabetic retinopathy status"
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes AS
SELECT person_id, "diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes" AS "diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes"
FROM aireadi.condition_occurrence;
-- Add index for faster joins
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_master_diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes ON temp_master_diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes (person_id);

-- TEMP TABLE FOR "diastolic blood pressure (mmhg, first measurement)", "diastolic blood pressure (mmhg, first measurement)", "diastolic blood pressure (mmhg, first measurement)"
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_diastolic_mmhg_1st;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_diastolic_mmhg_1st AS
SELECT person_id, "diastolic_mmhg_1st" AS "diastolic_mmhg_1st"
FROM aireadi.measurement;
-- Add index for faster joins
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_master_diastolic_mmhg_1st ON temp_master_diastolic_mmhg_1st (person_id);

-- TEMP TABLE FOR "age (years)"
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_master_age;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_master_age AS
SELECT person_id, "age" AS "age"
FROM aireadi.participants;
-- Add index for faster joins
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_master_age ON temp_master_age (person_id);

-- ALL UNIQUE PATIENT IDs
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp_all_ids;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_all_ids AS
SELECT person_id FROM temp_master_type_ii_diabetes
UNION
SELECT person_id FROM temp_master_diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes
UNION
SELECT person_id FROM temp_master_diastolic_mmhg_1st
UNION
SELECT person_id FROM temp_master_age;

-- Add index to the main ID table for the final join
CREATE INDEX idx_temp_all_ids_person_id ON temp_all_ids (person_id);

-- FINAL MASTER TABLE
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS final_master_table;
CREATE TABLE final_master_table AS
SELECT
    a.person_id,
    t0."type_ii_diabetes",
    t1."diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes",
    t2."diastolic_mmhg_1st",
    t3."age"
FROM temp_all_ids a
LEFT JOIN temp_master_type_ii_diabetes t0 ON a.person_id = t0.person_id 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes t1 ON a.person_id = t1.person_id 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_diastolic_mmhg_1st t2 ON a.person_id = t2.person_id 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_age t3 ON a.person_id = t3.person_id;

CREATE INDEX idx_final_master_person_id    
    ON final_master_table (person_id);
-- ========== STEP 1: Inclusion ==========

-- STEP 1.1: Includes all patients who reported to have diabetes
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_step1 AS
SELECT "person_id"
FROM final_master_table
WHERE "type_ii_diabetes" = 'Yes';

-- ========== STEP 2: Exclusions ==========

-- STEP 2.1: Exclude patients with missing diabetes status
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step1 AS
SELECT i."person_id"
FROM temp_inclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."person_id" = f."person_id"
WHERE f."type_ii_diabetes" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.2: Exclude patients with missing diabetic retinopathy status
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step2 AS
SELECT i."person_id"
FROM temp_exclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."person_id" = f."person_id"
WHERE f."diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.3: Exclude participants who did not report to have diabetes
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step3 AS
SELECT i."person_id"
FROM temp_exclusion_step2 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."person_id" = f."person_id"
WHERE f."type_ii_diabetes" = 'Yes';

-- STEP 2.4: Exclude patients with missing values in Diastolic blood pressure (mmHg, first measurement)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step4 AS
SELECT i."person_id"
FROM temp_exclusion_step3 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."person_id" = f."person_id"
WHERE f."diastolic_mmhg_1st" IS NOT NULL;

-- ========== STEP 3: Cohort ==========

-- The final temp table in the exclusion sequence becomes temp_cohort.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_cohort AS
SELECT "person_id"
FROM temp_exclusion_step4;

-- ========== STEP 4: Variables ==========

-- 4.1 Age (years)
-- Extract age (years) for the cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_age_years AS
SELECT c."person_id",
       f."age" AS "age_years"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."person_id" = f."person_id";

-- 4.2 Diastolic blood pressure (mmHg, first measurement)
-- Extract raw diastolic blood pressure for the cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_diastolic_bp_raw AS
SELECT c."person_id",
       f."diastolic_mmhg_1st"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."person_id" = f."person_id";

-- Assign diastolic blood pressure to custom bins
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_diastolic_blood_pressure_mmhg_first_measurement AS
SELECT "person_id",
       CASE
           WHEN "diastolic_mmhg_1st" IS NULL THEN NULL
           WHEN "diastolic_mmhg_1st" < 90 THEN '<90 (reference; group1)'
           WHEN "diastolic_mmhg_1st" >= 90 THEN '>=90 (hypertensive; group2)'
           ELSE NULL
       END AS "diastolic_blood_pressure_mmhg_first_measurement"
FROM temp_diastolic_bp_raw;

-- 4.3 Diabetic retinopathy presence
-- Extract raw diabetic retinopathy status for the cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_diabetic_retinopathy_raw AS
SELECT c."person_id",
       f."diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."person_id" = f."person_id";

-- Map diabetic retinopathy status to 'presence' or 'absence'
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_diabetic_retinopathy_presence AS
SELECT "person_id",
       CASE
           WHEN "diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes" = 'Yes' THEN 'presence'
           WHEN "diabetic_retinopathy_in_one_or_both_eyes" = 'No' THEN 'absence'
           ELSE NULL
       END AS "diabetic_retinopathy_presence"
FROM temp_diabetic_retinopathy_raw;

-- ========== STEP 5: Final Table ==========
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_final_table AS
SELECT
  c."person_id",
  age."age_years",
  dbp."diastolic_blood_pressure_mmhg_first_measurement",
  dr."diabetic_retinopathy_presence"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN temp_age_years age ON c."person_id" = age."person_id"
JOIN temp_diastolic_blood_pressure_mmhg_first_measurement dbp ON c."person_id" = dbp."person_id"
JOIN temp_diabetic_retinopathy_presence dr ON c."person_id" = dr."person_id";

-- ========== STEP 6: Final Output ==========
